en.summary: Tonsillitis causes sore throat, swollen tonsils, sometimes white spots, fever, difficulty swallowing. NHS: fluids, rest, soft foods, pharmacy pain relief; antibiotics only if clinician judges bacterial. Urgent care for breathing difficulty, drooling, severe swelling, or inability to swallow fluids. No invented antibiotic courses.
emergencyIf: Unable to swallow saliva / drooling with severe throat swelling
seeDoctorIf: Severe sore throat lasting more than a few days
Not able to swallow fluids comfortably
selfCare: Fluids; rest; soft foods; paracetamol/ibuprofen if suitable per label

fr.summary: L'amygdalite provoque mal de gorge, amygdales gonflées, parfois points blancs. Hydratation, repos ; antibiotiques seulement si avis médical. Urgence si détresse/salive impossible.

he.summary: דלקת שקדים: כאב גרון, שקדים נפוחים, לעיתים נקודות לבנות. נוזלים, מנוחה; אנטיביוטיקה רק לפי רופא. חירום בקושי נשימה/ריור.

ru.summary: Тонзиллит: боль в горле, отёк миндалин, иногда белые точки. Жидкость, покой; антибиотики только по решению врача. Неотложка при одышке/слюнотечении.
